definition: CrewAI is an open-source software framework and platform for building AI agents and multi-agent systems.
details: Written primarily in Python, it is used to define artificial-intelligence agents, assign tasks to them, and coordinate their work through agent teams and workflows. The framework is associated with CrewAI Inc., a startup developing enterprise tools for automating business workflows with large language model-based agents.

explainer.lead: How to install CrewAI, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.
explainer.createdBy: Created by João Moura in 2023; CrewAI, Inc.

quickstart.python:
from crewai import Agent, Crew, Task

researcher = Agent(role="Researcher", goal="Find key facts", backstory="A careful analyst.")
writer = Agent(role="Writer", goal="Write clear summaries", backstory="A friendly explainer.")
research = Task(description="List 3 facts about vector databases.", expected_output="3 bullets", agent=researcher)
summary = Task(description="Turn the facts into one paragraph.", expected_output="A paragraph", agent=writer)
print(Crew(agents=[researcher, writer], tasks=[research, summary]).kickoff())

explainer.inAi: Split a job across role-playing agents (researcher, writer, reviewer) that pass work along; tools and memory are pluggable.
explainer.jsNote: CrewAI is a Python library with no official JavaScript or TypeScript package; call it from a Python service if your app is written in JavaScript.

tiers.eli5: It's like a kit for hiring a small team of AI helpers, giving each one a job, and setting up how they pass work to each other.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use it to organize LLM-based agents into agent teams and workflows, with enterprise tooling from CrewAI Inc. for business automation. A pitfall is letting coordination overhead or unclear task assignment undermine the team's output.
tiers.paperLevel: An open-source framework and platform, primarily in Python, for defining AI agents, assigning tasks and coordinating work through agent teams and workflows. Its scope is agent orchestration, not model training.

explainer.example: A developer defines two agents in CrewAI, assigns each a task, and runs them as a team whose workflow produces the final output.
